scope: child and adult human silhouettes only; animal character styling excluded
scaling: At 1536x1024 use child 4/3 px and adult 3/2.5 px. Do not change stroke by body size within each role. Scale geometry and strokes together at export.
texture: subtle edge grain; no broken contours, double strokes or glow
existingRasterCompliance: unverified; this is the production standard for future work, not a claim that existing generated images already match

hair.baby: 既存の赤ちゃん見本を変更しない。
hair.toddler: 短い前髪と小さな頭頂の起伏。コーラルの線だけで描き、塗りは白。
hair.adult: 短髪を基本に、座って聞く姿勢はボブ、かがんで手を伸ばす姿勢は低い結び髪。簡潔なコーラルの輪郭線だけで描き、塗りは白。
avoid: 髪の量による年齢・発達区分
hair.sampleStatus: 幼児は簡潔な髪のv1見本、大人は短髪・ボブ・低い結び髪を混ぜたv2見本。線色・線幅の厳密な数値適合は未検証。
